text.tspan: T1/T2/T3/T4 2-N16 TRIMMERS EACH SIDE OF OPENING T&B
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES AND LEVELS IN METRES (AHD) UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
2. CONCRETE N40. COVER TO REINFORCEMENT 50 UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
4. LAP LENGTHS 50d MINIMUM UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
5. REINFORCEMENT INTERRUPTED BY OPENINGS SHALL BE CUT AND TRIMMER BARS PROVIDED AS SHOWN.
6. PIPE PENETRATIONS SHALL BE SEALED WITH NON-SHRINK GROUT AND FLEXIBLE JOINT TO PIPE SUPPLIER'S DETAILS.
7. ROOF SLAB REBATED 40 DEEP AROUND THE ACCESS OPENING FOR THE COVER FRAME. TOP REINFORCEMENT UNDER THE REBATE IS CRANKED DOWN 40 AT 1:2 (CRANKED / DROPPED BARS: B = CRANK DEPTH).
8. STEP IRONS GALVANISED OR PLASTIC ENCAPSULATED TO AUTHORITY STANDARD, AT 300 CTS, 350 WIDE, 150 PROJECTION.
9. DRAFT GENERATED BY LYNHCADTOOLSBOX - TO BE CHECKED BY THE DESIGN ENGINEER.
